chunks.heading: # Certificate of analysis for lot NF-3317
chunks.text:
# Certificate of analysis for lot NF-3317
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

Supplier: Cinderwell Specialty Gases. Material code GAS-NF3-O2. Lot NF-3317.

Moisture for lot NF-3317 is outside the purchase specification for the NF3/O2 mix. Lot NF-3317 was released to etch tools E-01 and E-02. This certificate is the supplier notice companion for lot NF-3317.

Do not apply lot NF-3317 to deposition, strip, or clean tools. A liner note on a single etch tool is not this certificate.

chunks.title: Showerhead qualification note for D-01
chunks.heading: # Showerhead qualification note for D-01
chunks.text:
# Showerhead qualification note for D-01
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

This note claims showerhead revision C is the only qualified build for D-01 and that the MES recipe header should be ignored when it disagrees.

It also claims the qualified deposit pressure is 9.5-12 Torr. That range is not the MPS-D7 recipe window. Treat the disagreement with the controlled SOP as unresolved and escalate. Do not pick a single revision from this note alone.

chunks.title: FMEA for MPS-E7 ESC temperature
chunks.heading: # FMEA for MPS-E7 ESC temperature
chunks.text:
# FMEA for MPS-E7 ESC temperature
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

chunks.title: FMEA for MPS-E7 ESC temperature
chunks.heading: ## Oscillation
chunks.text:
## Oscillation
Failure mode: ESC temperature oscillation on one chamber during oxide etch. One cause to review is an edge ring change. A preventive maintenance visit in the same week is a common confounder and needs its own timestamp.

chunks.title: FMEA for MPS-E7 ESC temperature
chunks.heading: ## Drift
chunks.text:
## Drift
Failure mode: etch rate drifting for weeks after a clean. Review RF hours since the last clean before citing a single lot or a single calibration record.

Severity for a one-chamber oscillation is high when the trace leaves the recipe window. Detection uses the chamber-to-chamber comparison.

chunks.title: O2 mass flow controller calibration procedure
chunks.heading: # O2 mass flow controller calibration procedure
chunks.text:
# O2 mass flow controller calibration procedure
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

chunks.title: O2 mass flow controller calibration procedure
chunks.heading: ## As found
chunks.text:
## As found
1. Record the controller serial, the tool, and the chamber.
2. Read as-found oxygen flow against the standard ash window 1500-2500 sccm.
3. If the due date has passed and no completion time is stored, the record stays overdue.

chunks.title: O2 mass flow controller calibration procedure
chunks.heading: ## Closeout
chunks.text:
## Closeout
A completed calibration writes the completion time and clears the overdue flag. A certificate for a different gas mixture does not close this procedure. File the work under the calibration id for that controller.

chunks.title: Service bulletin for edge ring revision C
chunks.heading: # Service bulletin for edge ring revision C
chunks.text:
# Service bulletin for edge ring revision C
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

Edge ring revision C changes the ESC thermal boundary on MPS-E7. Edge ring revision C was introduced for tool E-02 chamber A. The oxide etch main step still targets ESC temperature 48-56 C.

Edge ring revision C is a hardware change. Compare the engineering change effective time with the oscillation onset. A preventive maintenance work order in the same week is not the change that moved the thermal boundary. Edge ring revision C does not apply to E-01 unless that tool's config names the same part revision.

Verify the PLM config part name is the edge ring and the revision letter is C before recommending a corrective action.

chunks.title: Service bulletin for an overdue O2 mass flow controller
chunks.heading: # Service bulletin for an overdue O2 mass flow controller
chunks.text:
# Service bulletin for an overdue O2 mass flow controller
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

An overdue O2 mass flow controller on MPS-S7 leaves oxygen flow outside the ash window. The standard ash step window is 1500-2500 sccm. Tool S-02 chamber A is the scope when only that chamber steps.

A supplier notice for a different gas can arrive the day before and still sit inside its own spec. That notice does not close the overdue O2 mass flow controller record. Complete the calibration or keep the controller blocked.

Do not copy this bulletin onto an etch tool. Etch gas lots are a separate material path.

chunks.title: MPS-C7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: # MPS-C7 preventive maintenance
chunks.text:
# MPS-C7 preventive maintenance
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

This SOP covers fictional MPS-C7 clean tools C-01 and C-02.

chunks.title: MPS-C7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: ## Bath
chunks.text:
## Bath
On the SC1 step, hold bath temperature inside 62-68 C and megasonic power inside 600-800 W. A particle excursion during a bath change is logged as an NCR and is separate from an etch or deposition investigation.

chunks.title: MPS-C7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: ## Quartz
chunks.text:
## Quartz
Bath quartz from Bramble Quartz Components is a clean-tool spare. It is not an etch edge ring.

chunks.title: MPS-D7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: # MPS-D7 preventive maintenance
chunks.text:
# MPS-D7 preventive maintenance
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

This SOP covers fictional MPS-D7 deposition tools D-01 and D-02.

chunks.title: MPS-D7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: ## Deposit pressure
chunks.text:
## Deposit pressure
During PECVD oxide deposit, hold chamber pressure inside 3-4.5 Torr. Record the manometer reading before releasing the tool. A missing manometer calibration record is not replaced by a heater-thermocouple certificate.

chunks.title: MPS-D7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: ## Showerhead
chunks.text:
## Showerhead
Confirm the PLM showerhead revision matches the part installed on the tool. Do not overwrite a MES recipe header to force agreement. If the revisions disagree, escalate and keep both records.

chunks.title: MPS-E7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: # MPS-E7 preventive maintenance
chunks.text:
# MPS-E7 preventive maintenance
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

This SOP covers fictional MPS-E7 etch tools E-01 and E-02.

chunks.title: MPS-E7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: ## ESC temperature
chunks.text:
## ESC temperature
On the oxide etch main step, hold ESC temperature inside 48-56 C. Compare chamber A with chamber B before adjusting the loop. An oscillation that begins when an edge ring is replaced is a hardware boundary change.

chunks.title: MPS-E7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: ## Preventive maintenance
chunks.text:
## Preventive maintenance
A scheduled preventive maintenance work order does not by itself explain a new oscillation. Record the work order time and compare it with the trace onset.

chunks.title: MPS-S7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: # MPS-S7 preventive maintenance
chunks.text:
# MPS-S7 preventive maintenance
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

This SOP covers fictional MPS-S7 strip tools S-01 and S-02.

chunks.title: MPS-S7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: ## Oxygen flow
chunks.text:
## Oxygen flow
On the standard ash step, hold oxygen flow inside 1500-2500 sccm. Check the mass flow controller due date before the cassette starts. An overdue controller stays open until the calibration is completed.

chunks.title: MPS-S7 preventive maintenance
chunks.heading: ## Preventive maintenance
chunks.text:
## Preventive maintenance
Inspect the remote plasma source and write the work order id on the lot traveler. A supplier notice for a different gas is not a substitute for the overdue controller record.

chunks.title: Troubleshooting an etch rate step on both etch tools
chunks.heading: # Troubleshooting an etch rate step on both etch tools
chunks.text:
# Troubleshooting an etch rate step on both etch tools
Copyright (c) 2026 Bryan C. Weis and Common Consulting Company

When etch rate steps on both E-01 and E-02 after a shared gas delivery, start with the material lot and the supplier notice. A document-only liner note on one tool does not explain the same step on the other tool.

Check lot identity, material code, and which tools consumed the lot. Then read any engineering change and confirm its tool list. A change that names only E-01 cannot be the common cause of an E-02 step.

If the step is confined to one chamber and grows slowly for weeks, review RF hours since the last clean instead of a new lot.
